We are proud to be a Texas-based, woman-owned family business and understand our responsibility to our community. Southern Ice Cream has dedicated resources and financial contributions to Child Advocates of Fort Bend in efforts to stop child abuse. Each time you book an ice cream push cart party a portion of the proceeds go toward CAFB and this important cause.

In 2008, when Hurricane Ike hit the area, our facility became a FEMA distribution center, and Southern Ice Cream provided water, meals, and ice cream to over 200,000 families. The City of Stafford honored Southern Ice Cream's service to the community by dedicating July 3rd to the then-owners, Sharon and Michael Johnston, and they served as parade marshals on July 4th, 2009.
